_readme: Ready-to-use JSON-LD for circuits.com. Each key below is one <script type="application/ld+json"> block. Values in {{DOUBLE_BRACES}} match the placeholders tools/build-profiles.js already substitutes, or new ones it would need. Values in [SQUARE_BRACKETS] are facts only the owners can supply; delete the property rather than guess. Strip every key that starts with an underscore before publishing.

homepage_index_html._where: Replaces the existing block in index.html. Adds email, contactPoint and an optional founder list to the Organization; keeps WebSite. SearchAction is kept because it is harmless, but Google retired the sitelinks search box in November 2024, so expect no SERP feature from it.

@graph.name: Circuits.com
@graph.description: The circuits industry directory connecting suppliers, distributors, design engineers and manufacturers.
@graph._founder_note: Optional. contact.html can hide Mike's card (contact_hide_mike), so only list the people the owners want named in search engines. Add sameAs (LinkedIn etc.) only if the profiles exist.
@graph._sameAs_note: Add sameAs only once official social or company-registry profiles exist: [LinkedIn company page URL].

company_profile_template._where: Server-rendered into company.html by tools/build-profiles.js (one block per generated circuits.com/<handle> page), replacing the JS injection in profile.js jsonLd(). Omit any property whose value is empty. JSON-escape every value (JSON.stringify), and escape '<' as \u003c so a company name cannot close the script tag. Do not emit for sample pages.

job_detail_page_template._where: ONLY for a future one-job-per-URL page (for example circuits.com/jobs/<id>). Never on /jobs itself. Remove the page or return 404/410 once the job closes or paid_until passes.
job_detail_page_template.title: {{JOB_TITLE}}
job_detail_page_template.employmentType: {{FULL_TIME|PART_TIME|CONTRACTOR|INTERN, from a real field, not hard-coded}}
job_detail_page_template._remote_variant: For remote roles replace jobLocation with: "jobLocationType": "TELECOMMUTE", "applicantLocationRequirements": {"@type": "Country", "name": "{{COUNTRY}}"}
